d:
很喜欢co这三篇的画风，但一直没人翻译，所以我就用manga-translator翻了一下（看来确实不火，都这么久了还没汉化，我甚至找不到英化）
I really like the art style of these three works by co, but they've never been translated, so I went ahead and used manga-translator to translate them myself. (It seems they're really not popular—even after all this time, there's still no Chinese version, and I can't even find an English one.)
